Media Object

Media Object arranges a media element (image, avatar, or icon) alongside descriptive content, supporting horizontal and vertical alignment, lists, nesting, and actions.

Basic Media Object

An image on the left with content on the right.

IMG
Media Heading

This is the descriptive body content that sits alongside the media element.

HTML
<div class="zak-media">
  <div class="zak-media-body">
    <img src="..." alt="..." class="zak-media-figure">
  </div>
  <div class="zak-media-content">
    <h3 class="zak-media-title">Media Heading</h3>
    <p>Descriptive body content...</p>
  </div>
</div>

Media Object with Avatar

Use an avatar as the media element for user-centred content.

JT
Jane Thompson Product Designer

"The new design system has dramatically improved our workflow."

HTML
<div class="zak-media">
  <div class="zak-media-body">
    <span class="zak-avatar zak-avatar-lg zak-avatar-primary">JT</span>
  </div>
  <div class="zak-media-content">
    <strong>Jane Thompson</strong>
    <p>"The new design system..."</p>
  </div>
</div>

Media Object with Icon

Use an icon in a coloured container as the media element.

Verification Complete

Your account has been successfully verified and is now fully active.

HTML
<div class="zak-media">
  <div class="zak-media-body zak-media-icon zak-media-icon-success">
    <svg class="zak-icon">...</svg>
  </div>
  <div class="zak-media-content">
    <strong>Verification Complete</strong>
    <p>Your account has been verified.</p>
  </div>
</div>

Horizontal / Vertical Media Object

Media and content can be laid out horizontally (default) or stacked vertically.

H
Horizontal

Default side-by-side arrangement.

V
Vertical

Stacked top-to-bottom arrangement.

HTML
<!-- Horizontal (default) -->
<div class="zak-media">
  <div class="zak-media-body">...</div>
  <div class="zak-media-content">...</div>
</div>

<!-- Vertical -->
<div class="zak-media zak-media-vertical">
  <div class="zak-media-body">...</div>
  <div class="zak-media-content">...</div>
</div>

Media Object with Nested Content

Nest one media object inside another for threaded or hierarchical content such as comment replies.

SM
Sarah Miller 2h ago

Great release! The new components are fantastic.

DK
David Kim 1h ago

Agreed, the dark theme is beautiful too.

HTML
<div class="zak-media">
  <div class="zak-media-body">...</div>
  <div class="zak-media-content">
    <p>Parent comment</p>
    <div class="zak-media zak-media-nested">
      <div class="zak-media-body">...</div>
      <div class="zak-media-content">
        <p>Nested reply</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

CSS Classes Reference

Class Description
.zak-mediaBase media object
.zak-media-bodyMedia element wrapper
.zak-media-figureImage inside the media body
.zak-media-contentText/content area
.zak-media-titleTitle heading
.zak-media-verticalVertical stack orientation
.zak-media-iconIcon container in media body
.zak-media-icon-successSuccess-themed icon
.zak-media-listList of media objects
.zak-media-nestedNested (threaded) media object
.zak-media-actionsActions slot (right-aligned)

Accessibility

  • Media figures/images require meaningful alt text or alt="" if decorative.
  • When a media object is interactive, wrap content in a semantic link or button with focus styling.
  • Icon-based media should pair with visible text or an aria-label.
  • Use <ul>/<li> for media object lists so screen readers announce counts.
  • Nested/threaded content should preserve heading hierarchy and indentation for visual clarity.
